statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Did you know what the men intended when you entered?

statements.speaker: MARA
statements.text: No. I was told we were getting something signed at the bank.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Did anyone ask you to watch the doors or warn the others?

statements.speaker: MARA
statements.text: No. I was standing by the brochure stand. I did not know what was happening.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Why did you remain in the lobby during the alarm?

statements.speaker: MARA
statements.text: I froze. People were moving fast and I did not want to get hurt.

statements.speaker: MARA
statements.text: I saw one object raised but could not tell if it was real or what it was.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Was cash placed in a bag?

statements.speaker: MARA
statements.text: I did not see cash. I saw a bag but did not touch it.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Did you leave with the men?

statements.speaker: MARA
statements.text: I left when people ran toward the door. I was terrified.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Are you claiming you were not involved in any plan to rob the bank?

statements.speaker: MARA
statements.text: Yes. I did not agree to help anyone rob anyone.
